claims.evidence: Photos show the front and keys, but no clear close-ups of wear (scratches/dents) to confirm overall neat condition.
No photo/video evidence of power-on, sound output, or functional testing of keys/buttons.
“YAMAHA” text is visible, but the specific model “SX-600” is not readable/confirmed in the provided photos.
No evidence of key-by-key or button testing; only static images of the control panel and keys.
No photo shows the power adapter or included accessories.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No documentation or audio/video proof of no dead keys/no crackle; photos don’t confirm origin.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (photos only confirm Yamaha brand, not SX-600). Wrong model can significantly change value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label/serial plate (usually on the underside/back) showing “SX-600”, plus the full front panel model text if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha electronic keyboard/arranger with unknown model, worst-case for value.

risks.risk: Not actually working (dead keys, stuck buttons, faulty speakers, or intermittent power).
risks.proof: Short video: power on + playing across the full keyboard range + pressing every major button/slider; show speaker output and volume control working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially faulty (worst-case), assuming it may need repair.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage or heavy wear (cracked casing, missing knobs, worn keys, sticky controls).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: (1) both ends and corners, (2) underside, (3) control knobs/slider tops, (4) keybed surface for wear and any cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown cosmetic condition (worst-case), not assuming “neatly used”.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand/case parts).
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out: adapter (with matching plug), sustain pedal, and any stand/case components.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming adapter/pedal may be missing (worst-case), reducing value accordingly.

risks.risk: Connectivity/spec uncertainty (USB/MIDI, touch sensitivity, number of voices/speakers) affecting price.
risks.proof: Photo of the specs section from the manual or the back panel ports; or a screenshot of the exact model specs page.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for an unknown-spec Yamaha keyboard.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the underside/back serial/model label showing “Yamaha SX-600”.
Video proof of power-on with sound: play low-to-high keys, demonstrate volume, and press/operate all visible buttons/sliders.
Close-up photos of any wear/damage: corners, underside, and the control knobs/slider area.
Photo of included accessories: power adapter (and sustain pedal if any).
Photo of the back panel ports/connectivity (USB/MIDI etc.) or a manual/specs page for the exact model.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Yamaha electronic keyboard, but the specific model (SX-600) and working condition are not verifiable from the provided photos. Without power-on/function proof and a readable model label, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
